# Vancine

Use `vancine/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "vancine-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "vancine/deepseek-v4.1-flash",
});
```
